einzeiler: In May 1997, 20-year-old Keith Mann vanished after a mysterious late-night meeting.
kurzfassung: In May 1997, 20-year-old Keith Mann disappeared in Wichita Falls after returning home from celebrating his fiancee's graduation. Days later, a dealership car he had access to was found abandoned in a church parking lot with the driver's seat pushed back. Despite decades passing and various theories, no one has been named a suspect, and his family continues to search for answers.
stichpunkte: Keith Mann went missing on Mother's Day weekend in May 1997 in Wichita Falls, Texas.
His fiancee found his new apartment untouched, with his unmade bed and work clothes on the floor.
A red Ford Mustang from Keith's workplace was discovered parked in his former spot at a neighboring church.
The car's driver seat was adjusted for someone taller than Keith, who stood five feet seven inches.
On Saturday night, Keith spent time with coworkers before claiming he had a meeting scheduled for 12:15 a.m.
Police files contained heavy redactions, and early investigative steps regarding the vehicle were missed.
Investigators explored various rumors and excavated a demolished car wash lot in 2021 without finding evidence.
Keith's family continues to appeal for information and offers a reward for leads in the case.

clips.hook: An untouched apartment on move-in day
clips.text: When the missing man's fiancee arrived at their new home to move in as planned, she discovered that the space showed no signs of recent habitation.

clips.hook: A physical clue pointing away from the missing man
clips.text: An employee arriving to retrieve the abandoned vehicle noted that the driver's seat did not require adjustment, contradicting the missing person's usual driving posture.

clips.hook: A midnight meeting with an unknown person
clips.text: Before parting ways with friends for the evening, the twenty-year-old mentioned an appointment scheduled shortly after midnight but offered no further details.

clips.hook: Excavating a lot based on old photographs
clips.text: Detectives analyzed historical construction images to identify a newly poured concrete slab before digging up a commercial property years later.
Authorities established a significant monetary reward for tips that successfully result in an arrest related to the unsolved disappearance.

beschreibung:
It’s the kind of detail that lingers: a meeting, just after midnight… that no one can explain. In May 1997, 20-year-old Keith Mann was building a future—new apartment, new job, new fiancée. But sometime after being dropped off at home late that night, Keith stepped back out into the dark to meet someone. By morning, he was gone. The only thing left behind was a borrowed car from the dealership he’d been working at. Found abandoned in a church parking lot right next to his parent’s home. Decades later, that midnight meeting is still a mystery. No one has ever come forward. If you remember Keith or anything about his life in Wichita Falls in 1997, his family is still searching for answers.
You can share information or memories through the Missing Mann Project website or connect with them on the Missing Mann Project Facebook page, where they continue to keep Keith’s story alive – and hope that one day, the person he went to meet will finally be known.
